1809-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

862-5006-7272-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-5006-7272-8170.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
862-5006-7272-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1981-2415-7452-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-7452-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1531-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-7082-8095.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7235.easyPrerequisites: There are at least X total creatures on the battlefield.
3899-6972-7235.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7782-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1116-2738-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sek'Kuar, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1978-2347-3099-5793.description:
Activate Firemind Vessel by tapping it, adding two mana.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Firemind Vessel which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

5109-7839-7841.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Smaug and you. You cannot lose the game due to Darksteel Angel
Smaug triggers, creating an amount of Treasure tokens equal to the damage it was dealt.

3430-4019-4221--85.easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
3430-4019-4221--85.description:
Play the land card.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
3430-4019-4221--85.notes: You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

1263-2292-4871-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have attacked this turn.
You have max speed.
1263-2292-4871-6255.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
392-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-2034-5434-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-4377-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4036-5026-7497.description:
Cast Wisdom of Ages by paying {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, copying Wisdom of Ages.
Resolve the copy of Wisdom of Ages, returning all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3641-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3641-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-5295-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5295-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2351-6460-7175.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-6460-7175.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2692-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4050-4396-5010-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-4772-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-4772-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

3197-4716-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4716-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1849-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

650-710-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

804-1479-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1165-2861-3769.notablePrerequisites:
Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1165-2861-3769.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving control of Archfiend of the Dross to the damaged opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

2034-3969-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Knight of the Last Breath, adding {C}{C}.
When Knight of the Last Breath dies, its afterlife ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Knight of the Last Breath trigger, creating three 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Knight of the Last Breath from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2034-4813-5003.notablePrerequisites: An opponent lost life this turn.
2034-4813-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Famished Foragers, adding {C}{C}.
Famished Foragers dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.

1987-2510-2556.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2510-2556.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mnemonic Wall and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.

614-1964-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
614-1964-1987-3075.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
